headline: Target shows strong recovery momentum with revenue growth and sales outlook boost, signaling improved operational health

signals.summary: Target boosts sales outlook as recovery efforts gain ground, with Q2 2026 revenue of $26.54B and EPS of $4.11, demonstrating positive momentum
signals.suggestedAction: Use growth trajectory as talking point in renewal discussions; explore opportunities to support expanded operations
